postcheck.description: Every seeded raid carries its catalog metadata
postcheck.sql:
SELECT NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM (VALUES ('aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa', 1, false, 1302, NULL, NULL), ('bbbbbbbb-bbbb-4bbb-8bbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb', 2, true, 1320, 53, NULL), ('cccccccc-cccc-4ccc-8ccc-cccccccccccc', 3, true, 1317, 53, 3379)) AS e(id, "sortOrder", "trackLockouts", "blizzardInstanceId", "wclZoneId", "wclRankingEncounterId")
  LEFT JOIN "raid" r ON r.id = e.id
  WHERE r.id IS NULL
     OR r."sortOrder" <> e."sortOrder"
     OR r."trackLockouts" <> e."trackLockouts"
     OR r."blizzardInstanceId" IS DISTINCT FROM e."blizzardInstanceId"::int4
     OR r."wclZoneId" IS DISTINCT FROM e."wclZoneId"::int4
     OR r."wclRankingEncounterId" IS DISTINCT FROM e."wclRankingEncounterId"::int4
) AS ok
